note: Based on recorded events; coverage is more limited before the year 2000. Longer historical trends may partly reflect reporting improvements.
title: Decadal average: Annual death rate from all natural disasters excluding extreme temperatures
subtitle: Death rates are measured as the number of deaths per 100,000 people. Decadal figures are measured as the annual average over the subsequent ten-year period. Disasters include events such as earthquakes, volcanoes, droughts, wildfires, storms, and floods. Extreme temperatures are not included here because their geographical and time coverage is poor, making consistent comparisons difficult.
